title: ArtCraft: the IDE for artists
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-11. github.com/storytold/artcraft: 15.4k stars (3,222 that day), 2.5k forks, MIT or Apache-2.0; 'The IDE for artists'; 'the IDE for interactive AI image and video creation. Compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and choose the models that fit your work. Turn prompting into crafting'; 'Build the scene before you generate it'; Image to Location (virtual actors in a consistent environment, multiple shots in the same room); 3D and 2D image compositing; Image to 3D Mesh (an object you can position, rotate and frame); Character Posing (pose characters and set your camera before generating); Scene Blocking with Kitbashing (3D asset kits); Character Identity Transfer (a posed mannequin guides placement and pose); background removal; mixed assets; text to image; prompted image editing; canvas editing with masks and inpainting; image to video; providers: ArtCraft (62-model catalog), Grok, Midjourney, Sora, World Labs (Marble worlds with Gaussian splats); planned Kling, Google, Runway, Luma; Windows and macOS releases, Linux by building from source. getartcraft.com: open-source studio; 'Free to start · No subscription'; /pricing: 'Free & open source · Subscriptions optional', 'bring your own compute and third-party subscriptions'; plans Basic $8/mo billed yearly ($96) for 1,000 credits, Pro $28, Max $48. Voice: ElevenLabs (Chris, eleven_v4).

lines.text: Every AI image tool works the same way: you type a prompt, and you pray.
say: Every A I image tool works the same way: you type a prompt, and you pray.

lines.text: This one lets you build the scene first, like a film set, and only then generate.
say: This one lets you build the scene first, like a film set, and only then generate.

lines.text: It's called ArtCraft. It's free, open source, and it just picked up over three thousand GitHub stars in a single day.
say: It's called ArtCraft. It's free, open source, and it just picked up over three thousand GitHub stars in a single day.

lines.text: Its makers call it the IDE for artists: one app where you compose in 2D and stage scenes in 3D.
say: Its makers call it the I D E for artists: one app where you compose in two D and stage scenes in three D.

lines.text: Drop in a room, place your actors, and pose them like mannequins.
say: Drop in a room, place your actors, and pose them like mannequins.

lines.text: Then put the camera exactly where you want it, and frame the shot.
say: Then put the camera exactly where you want it, and frame the shot.

lines.text: Turn any picture into a 3D object you can rotate, and kitbash whole sets from asset kits.
say: Turn any picture into a three D object you can rotate, and kitbash whole sets from asset kits.

lines.text: Then you generate, and your posed mannequins guide where the characters stand.
say: Then you generate, and your posed mannequins guide where the characters stand.

lines.text: Keep the same room for every shot, so a whole sequence stays consistent.
say: Keep the same room for every shot, so a whole sequence stays consistent.

lines.text: Want a quick idea instead? Type a prompt, edit with a mask, or turn a still into video.
say: Want a quick idea instead? Type a prompt, edit with a mask, or turn a still into video.

lines.text: It plugs into a long list of models, including Midjourney, Sora, Grok and World Labs' 3D worlds.
say: It plugs into a long list of models, including Midjourney, Sora, Grok and World Labs' three D worlds.

lines.text: The app is free. Generating isn't: bring your own subscriptions, or buy credits, from 8 dollars a month billed yearly.
say: The app is free. Generating isn't: bring your own subscriptions, or buy credits, from eight dollars a month, billed yearly.

lines.text: It runs on Windows and Mac, and on Linux if you build it yourself.
say: It runs on Windows and Mac, and on Linux if you build it yourself.

lines.text: Stop prompting and praying. Start directing.
say: Stop prompting and praying. Start directing.

lines.text: That's today's tool. Subscribe, there's a new one every day.
say: That's today's tool. Subscribe, there's a new one every day.
